gates.requiredScope: The accepted intake, Ready ten-target series review, completed source-reference prerequisite, feature identity, branch and current MergeAndSync authority remain hash-aligned.
gates.rationale: Remote delivery may proceed only from current immutable lineage and explicit authority.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Any intake, review, series, branch, authority or run-state drift.

gates.requiredScope: Field/session, typed binding, converter, rollback, async snapshot, recursive ownership, strict JSON and trusted registry contracts pass their targeted Release suites.
gates.rationale: Phases 1 through 4 are one product feature and require direct executable proof.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Any Controls, Serialization, binding, validation, transaction or registry change.

gates.requiredScope: FormTransaction drives the real application loop and proves visible transaction, persistence, reject, cancellation, stale and Help Description behavior.
gates.rationale: The learner-facing example is the integration acceptance surface.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Any example, adapter, control, status, help or app-loop change.

gates.requiredScope: Release build, all solution tests, five assembly-specific Coverlet thresholds, XML configuration and format verification pass at the recorded build versions.
gates.rationale: Repository policy requires complete regression, coverage and style evidence.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Any product, test, project, solution, coverage, format or version change beyond final version alignment.

gates.requiredScope: The versioned JSON allowlist, size/depth/item limits, no-partial-model behavior, trusted registry boundary, no-copy provenance and secret scans remain secure.
gates.rationale: Declarative data and external provenance are explicit trust boundaries.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Any JSON grammar, registry, reflection, external-source, dependency or secret-scan change.

gates.requiredScope: German-first and English-second CEFR-B2 documentation, generated API pages, text-first output and WCAG-oriented smoke proof remain complete.
gates.rationale: Public APIs and the learner-facing example require discoverable accessible documentation.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Any public API, guide, navigation, language, accessibility or generated-documentation change.

gates.requiredScope: Source policy, Bash/PowerShell governance parity, homogeneity, agent parity, project statistics, diff integrity and autonomous task state remain current.
gates.rationale: The feature changes shared governance and evidence surfaces in addition to product code.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Any policy, agent, template, series, statistics, task or evidence drift.

gates.requiredScope: The exact reviewed feature head is pushed, every required GitHub technical check passes on Ubuntu, macOS and Windows, no actionable review thread remains, and provider-neutral PreMerge evidence validates.
gates.rationale: Admin authority never substitutes for exact-head technical or review convergence.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Any head, workflow, check, rerun, review thread or authority change.

gates.requiredScope: After all technical gates pass, the explicitly authorized admin bypass covers only the remaining approval rule; the PR uses a merge commit, branches are cleaned and local main is fast-forwarded to origin/main.
gates.rationale: MergeAndSync and the narrow bypass were explicitly authorized in the current user turn.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Any failed technical gate, actionable review, merge failure, branch-cleanup failure or default-branch drift.
